# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** 15 years old by Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 c1 P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v3 c1 P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v5 c3 P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c4 P15](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is an extremely lovely girl with rosy cheeks, dark eyes, and black hair. She has a neat, polite appearance and is noted for being plump and having charming dimples on her cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c19 P14](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0014)_

## Personality

Lucy has a practical, cheerful, and well-behaved disposition. She is naturally good, tidy, and reliable, rarely causing any trouble. She loves reading books and holds a strong belief in proper conduct, being hesitant about actions she perceives as unladylike or improper.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P48](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0048)_

- To be bosom friends with Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>

## History

Lucy resides at Pear Hill near Pembroke's Pond in Brierley. After returning home from a visit to her aunt in Delford, she meets Nell Harcourt in her garden and the two make a solemn vow across a path to be bosom friends forever. Soon after, she unintentionally consumes three large glassfuls of homemade currant wine at Grey Shutters, causing her mother to forbid her from playing with Nell until the misunderstanding is resolved following Posy Fay's croup illness. During a picnic, she accidentally gets intoxicated on homemade wine after drinking three tumblerfuls, causing her mother to temporarily ban her from playing with Nell. Later, Nell accidentally causes a dispute when she breaks her slate over Hugh Carrow's head after he teases her, leading to a temporary rift that Lucy tries to mediate. She is forbidden by her mother from playing with Nell again for a time, leading to a tearful farewell at the spring. Eventually, her mother learns the truth about Nell's innocence regarding the wine and permits their friendship to resume. Lucy attends the Brierley Debating Club concert alongside Nell, sleeping over at the Pembroke home where they accidentally jump onto Aunt Lavinia in the spare room. Over the years, she remains Nell's closest companion through their school days, the formation of the Brierley Village Improvement Society, and their eventual transition into adulthood.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c15 P50](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0050), [v1 c16 P22](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0022), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P59](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0059), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)_
